# API Reference

Generated from public class and function docstrings by `docs/generate_api_reference.py`.

This reference lists public definitions in source modules, including class methods, properties and declared attributes. Explicit constructor signatures are shown; synthesized dataclass constructors and inherited members are not expanded. Attributes include dataclass input/result fields. Re-exports and module constants are not repeated. No source code is executed.

For model selection, units and worked examples, use the [user manual](manual.md), [capability map](index.md) and [validation matrix](../validation_matrix.md).
